subject: Strategic retention – Novus Health renewal and concession package
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@novushealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal negotiation and timeline

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the renewal convo earlier. We're under pressure from the board to reduce SaaS spend this quarter. I wanted to put our position in writing so we can be clear about what will get us to sign: 

- A one-time customer success credit of $75k applied to the first invoice at renewal.
- A 20% list discount on Year 2 ARR.
- Contract term reset to a 12-month lookback (we currently have rolling 24-month pricing cadence).
- A 99.9% SLA commit or a 10% service credit on outages over threshold.

If Redwood can confirm the above by next Wednesday (9/16) we can route to our CFO and legal for a quick turnaround. Otherwise, we will likely pilot alternative vendors.

Attaching a summary for your review (see: concession request). Happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Emma
Emma Jones
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novus Health
Attachment: Novus_Concession_Summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal negotiation and timeline — Novus Health (requesting exec signoff)

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding Novus' concession ask. High-level: 20% discount + $75k one-time credit + term reset + SLA ask. Renewal triggers next week; they want confirmation by 9/16.

Why I think we should consider:
- Novus is long-standing (3 yrs), currently at $1.2M ARR.
- Churn risk feels elevated; they are being consolidated under a central procurement review.
- Upside: they are evaluating additional embeddings usage; retaining them preserves ~$400k pipeline near-term.

Request: please advise if we can approve the full package, partial (discount vs credit), or if we should propose an alternative. I've attached my concession summary and proposed staged approval language for the contract team.

Attachments: Novus_Concession_Summary.pdf, Novus_Renewal_Term_Sheet.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior AE, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0148
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal negotiation and timeline — Novus Health (requesting exec signoff)

Appreciate the heads-up, Laura. Quick thoughts:

- 20% on $1.2M ARR is material (~$240k ARR impact). Combined with a $75k one-time credit, the near-term revenue hit is large and sets precedent.
- Need finance run: what does this do to net ARR, commission recoup, and FY26 targets? Rishi, please provide margin impact and last-paid discounts.
- SLA: we can offer a 30-day credit window for incidents >99.9% as an alternative to a standing credit. That limits ongoing exposure.

Propose a counter we can approve rapidly: 10% list discount + $40k one-time credit + SLA contingency credit (30-day mechanism) + 12-month term reset conditional on 24-month minimum revenue commitment. This protects revenue and shows flexibility.

If they push back hard we can escalate to Marissa for final signoff, but I prefer not to pre-sign a 20% concession.

Vivek
SVP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal negotiation and timeline — Novus Health (requesting exec signoff)

Agree with Vivek's conservative counter. Novus is strategic for our healthcare vertical stories but we must protect near-term revenue. My recommended path:

1) Accept 10% list discount (year 2)
2) One-time credit capped at $40k contingent on signed amendment by 9/24 and payment of the first renewal invoice on schedule
3) Term reset to 12 months only if they commit to a minimum renewal ARR floor (no less than $1.05M) and a short-term pilot expansion clause (3-month usage review)
4) SLA: provide 99.9% target with incident credit mechanism (not an open-ended credit).

I'll back the signoff if Legal prepares the amendment language and Finance signs off on commission adjustments.

-Marcus
Director, Account Strategies
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Renewal negotiation and timeline — Novus Health (requesting exec signoff)

Thanks team — I reviewed the suggested counter and the commercial impact. Given the retention risk and strategic value, I approve Marcus' recommended package with one edit: increase the one-time credit to $50k (midpoint) subject to the same conditions (signed amendment by 9/24, ARR floor $1.05M).

Please proceed:
- Laura: deliver the formal counter to Emma today, confirm DocuSign timeline, and get Novus Legal contact looped in.
- Rishi/Finance: finalize margin and commission adjustments and confirm ability to book with this concession.
- Legal: prepare amendment draft and include the SLA incident-credit language (30-day credit mechanism).

This is my final authorization for Deal Desk — route through the standard approval form and attach this thread.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
